description: Universal indicator with thermocouple, Pt100, mA, V, logic and frequency input, two alarms with relays and analog retransmission: displayed value, status, alarms, input, linearisation and output settings
source: DLG IM-111 user manual MAN-PT-DE-IM111-01.00_13 (Portuguese), section 8

sources.title: Indicador Universal Modbus IM-111 – Manual do usuário
sources.note: linked in issue #444; section 8, Modbus table and bit masks

notes: Modbus RTU over RS485 (terminals 10 +, 11 -, 12 shield). Address 1 to 255; 9600 to 115200 baud; even, odd or no parity; response delay 10 to 200 ms.
The manual lists the registers as 40001 on with an offset column from 0; the map uses the offset, as sent on the wire.
Values are signed 16-bit integers; the displayed and engineering values use the decimal places in 40018. The manual does not give the scaling of the ambient temperature or the analog output value.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
